verdict.rationale: v0 documents connecting projects to third-party services from the builder, including databases (Upstash, Neon), Supabase and AI providers, with secure storage for API keys. It also claims full-stack scaffolding, and one community report describes building an app with auth and roles. However, the evidence never names payment or email integrations, and server-side functions are only implied by the 'full-stack' and 'connect to backend' claims. Missing for 10: explicit payments (e.g. Stripe) and email integrations, documentation of authoring server-side functions/API routes in the builder, independent hands-on corroboration of these integrations.
